description: Animals/Pets system: wild animals with biome-aware spawning, behavior AI (wander/idle/flee), taming via feeding, pet following player with pathfinding. Includes AnimalComponent, AnimalSystem, animal catalogue, taming/pet ops, new items (animal_feed, pet_treat), NPC rancher 'Hana', and full i18n across 12 locales.
steps: 1. Add new item types to packages/shared/src/items.ts: 'animal_feed' and 'pet_treat' to the ItemId union and ITEM_DEFINITIONS record.

2. Create packages/game-engine/src/animals/ directory with: animalDefinitions.ts (AnimalSpecies enum, AnimalDefinition interface with id, nameKey, biomes, tamingFeedCount, speed, fleeDistance, textureKey; catalogue of 4-5 species: rabbit, deer, fox, bird, turtle), animalOps.ts (pure functions: canTame, feedAnimal, tickWander, tickFlee, tickFollow, rollSpawnChance, pickWanderTarget), animalState.ts (AnimalBehavior type: 'idle'|'wander'|'flee'|'follow'|'tamed_idle'), index.ts re-exporting public API.

3. Create packages/game-engine/src/components/AnimalComponent.ts extending Component('animal') with fields: speciesId, behavior (AnimalBehavior), ownerId (string|null for tamed animals), feedCount, wanderTarget ({x,y}|null), wanderTimer, fleeTimer, version.

4. Create packages/game-engine/src/systems/AnimalSystem.ts extending System with requiredComponents ['position','animal','velocity']. Logic: idle animals occasionally pick a wander target, wandering animals move toward target then go idle, animals flee when player is within fleeDistance, tamed animals follow their owner with simple path toward owner position. Feed interaction: when player interacts facing an animal tile, consume animal_feed, increment feedCount, if feedCount >= tamingFeedCount then set ownerId and behavior to 'follow'.
5. Add new NPC 'rancher_hana' to packages/game-engine/src/world/NpcCatalogue.ts with role 'rancher', add 'rancher' to NpcRole type, add schedule, add 'ranch' to NpcActivity type in npcSchedule.ts.
6. Add dialogue tree for Hana in packages/game-engine/src/dialogue/ following existing patterns (dialogueTrees.ts or similar). Hana explains animal taming and sells animal_feed.
7. Add animal-related quest to packages/game-engine/src/quests/questDefinitions.ts: 'tame_animal' quest given by Hana with objective kind 'tame' count 1.
8. Add quest objective kind 'tame' to QuestObjective union type and wire progress tracking in questOps.ts.

9. Add 2 new achievements to packages/game-engine/src/achievements/achievementDefinitions.ts: 'first_tame' (tame 1 animal) and 'animal_friend' (tame 3 animals). Add 'tame' condition kind to AchievementCondition.
10. Export new components and systems from packages/game-engine/src/index.ts and packages/game-engine/src/components/index.ts and packages/game-engine/src/systems/index.ts.

11. Add i18n keys to all 12 locale files in apps/web/src/i18n/messages/*.ts: item.animal_feed, item.pet_treat, npc.hana.name, npc.activity.ranch, dialogue.hana.*, animal.rabbit/deer/fox/bird/turtle, achievement.first_tame.*, achievement.animal_friend.*, quest.tame_animal.*, fishing-style taming status messages.
12. Update ITEM_NAME_KEYS in apps/web/src/i18n/index.ts for the new items. Add NPC_ACTIVITY_KEYS entry for 'ranch'.

13. Write comprehensive tests in packages/game-engine/src/__tests__/animals.test.ts covering: animal definition validation, taming ops (feed increments, taming threshold), behavior state machine (idle->wander->idle, flee triggers, follow logic), AnimalSystem update with entities, spawn chance rolling.
14. Run pnpm format && pnpm lint && pnpm build && pnpm test to verify.
acceptance_criteria: ItemId type includes 'animal_feed' and 'pet_treat' with valid ITEM_DEFINITIONS entries
AnimalComponent exists as pure data with 'animal' type string
AnimalSystem processes entities with position+animal+velocity components
animalOps.ts contains pure functions for taming and behavior logic
4-5 animal species defined with biome associations and taming thresholds
NPC Hana added with rancher role, schedule, and dialogue tree
Quest 'tame_animal' and achievements 'first_tame'/'animal_friend' are properly defined
All 12 locale files have matching keys for all new user-facing strings
All tests pass including new animals.test.ts with at least 15 test cases
pnpm build succeeds with no type errors
findings: Added totalAnimalsTamed counter to AchievementComponent and wired it into AchievementSystem.buildSource. Updated NPC_COLORS in apps/web for new rancher role. Updated SQL migration 004 with new shop prices and quest rewards. Had to compact all 12 locale files by removing blank lines to stay under 300-line limit. The 'tame' quest objective uses entry.progress (incremented by recordTame) like 'talk' and 'donate' objectives.
